about.title: About Sunday Maison
about.text1: Sunday Maison is a female-led event brand based in Ireland, created to bring beauty, gourmet dining, delicate styling, and effortless atmosphere together in one seamless experience.
about.text2: With a rich background in beauty and hospitality, we understand how important it is for every detail to feel personal, elegant, and stress-free. Our mission is to make every bride, birthday girl, and host feel truly special, cared for, and relaxed.
